title: SpaceSmithing

body:
[![Support me](https://i.imgur.com/g8Ob1Go.png)](https://ko-fi.com/klaidi4)

# ✨ SpaceSmithing — The Cosmic Smithing Table!
**SpaceSmithing** is a plugin that brings the upgraded **1.20+ smithing table** mechanics to players on older Minecraft clients. If your server runs on a 1.20+ core but supports older versions, this plugin ensures everyone can access the new smithing features seamlessly.

---

### 🔥 Features
* ✅ **Full Emulation** — All 1.20 smithing mechanics work perfectly on legacy clients.
* ✅ **Custom GUI Support** — Native integration with **ItemsAdder**, **Nexo**, and **Oraxen**.
* ✅ **Cross-Version Experience** — Bridge the gap between versions with no feature loss.
* ✅ **Seamless Integration** — Easy setup to match your server's unique style.

---

### 🎨 Custom Assets
* 📥 **[Download Custom GUI Templates](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/i068b6d67n47h2d0fibz1/SpaceSmithing.zip?rlkey=fz6fi9j4g86d7cd11nmjs98nx&st=5k0hf9iw&dl=1)**

---

### 🛠 Dependencies
* **ViaVersion**
* **PlaceholderAPI**

---

### 💎 Why SpaceSmithing?
Minecraft 1.20 introduced major changes to armor upgrades and smithing templates. Players on older clients normally cannot see or use these new interfaces. **SpaceSmithing** fixes this by delivering a functional, high-quality GUI that works for everyone.
